articles.headline: Carabao Cup draw: Fleetwood draw Arsenal, Liverpool vs. Chelsea
articles.description: League Two side Fleetwood Town will host Arsenal in the fourth round of the Carabao Cup, while Liverpool will host Chelsea.

articles.headline: Chelsea boss Xabi Alonso thanks Todd Boehly, Mark Walter after sale
articles.description: Chelsea manager Xabi Alonso has thanked outgoing co-owners Todd Boehly and Mark Walter, who have sold their stakes in the club, and hailed the ownership change as an "important day."

articles.headline: Chelsea's João Pedro withdraws from Brazil squad with injury
articles.description: Chelsea striker João Pedro has withdrawn from the Brazil squad because of injury.

articles.headline: Unai Emery on Alejandro Garnacho's lack of Aston Villa minutes: He's 'a little bit behind'
articles.description: Alejandro Garnacho was an unused substitute again for Aston Villa in their 3-1 win over Coventry City in the Carabao Cup -- for the third game in a row.

articles.headline: Boehly, Walter sell Chelsea stakes as Clearlake takes full control
articles.description: Clearlake Capital has taken full control of Chelsea after acquiring the ownership stakes of Mark Walter and Todd Boehly, the Premier League club announced Wednesday.

articles.headline: João Pedro wants a new nickname for Chelsea's goalscoring trio
articles.description: João Pedro called for a new nickname for Chelsea's in-form front three as he discussed his growing understanding with Cole Palmer and Morgan Rogers.

articles.headline: VAR right not to send off Arsenal's Gabriel for Emi Martínez kick, panel finds
articles.description: The referee and VAR were correct not to issue a red card to Arsenal defender Gabriel for his kick to the head of Chelsea goalkeeper Emiliano Martínez earlier this month, a panel has found.

articles.headline: Cole Palmer temporarily suspended from Twitch after streaming EA FC 27 early: 'Unban me pls'
articles.description: Chelsea midfielder Cole Palmer was temporarily suspended from Twitch on Tuesday after streaming EA Sports FC 27 before the game's release.

articles.headline: All 20 Premier League teams ranked: Which managers will be fired first?
articles.description: The Premier League is a constant carousel of coaches being fired and hired. Who's safe and who's on the chopping block? Let's rank everyone!

articles.headline: Former Arsenal, Nottingham Forest chief Edu Gaspar joins Bulgarian side Levski Sofia
articles.description: Edu Gaspar has been appointed to the Board of Directors at Bulgarian side Levski Sofia following his departure from Nottingham Forest.

articles.headline: Manchester derby defined by VAR drama; Real Madrid booed; Chelsea bullied by Hull
articles.description: Sunday's Manchester derby was fascinating and not just because of the referee/VAR errors. Also: Real Madrid get booed again, and Chelsea should be worried after being bullied by Hull City, as Gab Marcotti recaps the weekend.

articles.headline: Alonso: Chelsea have been 'punished' over defensive problems
articles.description: Alonso: Chelsea have been 'punished' over defensive problems

articles.headline: Belloumi's double leads Hull City in draw against Chelsea
articles.description: Mohamed Belloumi nets a quickfire double as Hull City continue to surprise in the Premier League with an entertaining 2-2 draw at Chelsea.

articles.headline: Premier League recap: Arsenal get big win at Sunderland, Spurs still winless
articles.description: What a Saturday! Defending champs Arsenal dug deep to win 2-0 at Sunderland, Tottenham's search for a win -- and a goal -- continues as they drew 0-0 vs. Everton, and Chelsea had to settle for a 2-2 draw vs. Hull.

articles.headline: Hull continue unbeaten Premier League streak with entertaining 2-2 draw at Chelsea
articles.description: Hull continued their unbeaten start to the Premier League season after an entertaining 2-2 draw at Chelsea.

articles.headline: Xabi Alonso wants more 'boring' wins as Chelsea draw with Hull
articles.description: Xabi Alonso says his Chelsea side must show more desire in defence, and warns it will take time to fix their frailties at the back after they drew 2-2 with Hull City at Stamford Bridge on Saturday.

articles.headline: Nicol: Chelsea's defence isn't good enough to win the title
articles.description: Nicol: Chelsea's defence isn't good enough to win the title

articles.headline: Chelsea draw with Premier League surprise package Hull City
articles.description: Chelsea's chaotic start to life under Xabi Alonso continued with an entertaining 2-2 draw against Hull at Stamford Bridge.

articles.headline: In-form Hull show why Chelsea fans are in for a rough ride this season
articles.description: Chelsea have a star-studded attack which has saved them many times already this season, but their defense was exposed again vs. an impressive Hull City.

articles.headline: Xabi Alonso on Chelsea's João Pedro: Like Karim Benzema, as good as Erling Haaland
articles.description: Chelsea boss Xabi Alonso has compared striker João Pedro to the like of Erling Haaland and Karim Benzema following his flying start to the Premier League this season.
